name: Large Creature Critical Strike Table

notes.columns: Columns are the attacking weapon's enchantment class (Normal / Magic / Mithril / Holy Arms / Slaying).

rollMatchPolicy: rollMin / rollMax inclusive. Attacks vs large creatures can exceed 100; bands run to 251+ and rolls above the top band clamp to it.

normal.text: Weapon shatters on foe's solid form.

magic.text: You fumble your weapon (roll on the fumble table).

mithril.text: Your weapon bites hard, but you move poorly. Lose initiative.

holy.text: Glancing blow shakes you up. You suffer a -10 penalty next round.

slaying.text: Blade touches foe's exposed skin. Your weapon hisses.

magic.text: Blow to foe's side. Pretty sparks.

mithril.text: Your weapon glances off foe's side and leaves a measurable wound.

holy.text: Your swing lands lightly. You had hoped for better.

slaying.text: Your blow is solid, but lands on a well protected area.

normal.text: Hardly enough for victory. Weak side strike.

magic.text: Your blade guides itself in, but you miss the opportunity.

mithril.text: Blow to shoulder. It's well placed, but you'll need a lucky shot at this pace.

holy.text: Your strike lands solid and righteous. You wish it had landed a little more.

slaying.text: A mortal blow poorly placed. Maybe you're holding it wrong?

normal.text: Strong blow to foe's forearm yields its measure.

magic.text: You give out an epic strike, but foe is an epic creature.

mithril.text: Your strike is solid, but your grip fails on impact.

holy.text: You trip foe and slam his shin with your weapon. You are not being noble.

slaying.text: Bruise to foe's shoulder is made worse by your weapon's strong enchantment.

normal.text: Strike to beast's chest. Some unseen piece of protection blocks your attack.

magic.text: Hard strike to foe's thigh. It glances off. You really wish that had landed better.

mithril.text: Your strike lands in a critical spot on foe's abdomen. You are unable to mortally wound him, for the moment.

holy.text: Your weapon sparks against the beast's hide and he realizes its mighty blessing.

slaying.text: Your weapon strikes foe like a clap of thunder, clawing at his very essence.

normal.text: Strike lands upon foe's side. He responds by leaping back away from you.

magic.text: Your blade bites into foe's skin with a hiss. Foe roars out at you. You ready yourself for what comes next.

mithril.text: Hack at foe's neck, landing on his shoulder. He moves before the strike bites deeper.

holy.text: Heavy blow with all of your weight behind it hits foe in his side.

slaying.text: Your weapon drives deep into foe's abdomen. Blood pours out of foe. He looks like a statue in a fountain.

normal.text: Blow crashes into foe's leg. The damage is obvious by the look on his face.

magic.text: Blow to foe's back. It concerns him greatly. Good luck.

mithril.text: Grip foe's hide for leverage, before you strike. Blow lands solid, but he throws you clear.

holy.text: Strike lands lightly against foe's shoulder. You have the initiative for 3 rounds. Foe's blood gets all over you.

slaying.text: Cave in the side of foe's head. Foe is down and dies in 2 rounds. Your foot is pinned under him for a round.

normal.text: Well placed strike to foe's neck severs the jugular vein. Foe falls and dies in 6 rounds.

magic.text: Vicious strike to abdominal region destroys a variety of organs. Foe falls over with a crash. He dies in 3 rounds.

mithril.text: Strike to foe's heart. He dies instantly. You hit him one more time to make sure he is dead. Very clean kill.

holy.text: Drive home your attack right between your foe's eyes. He dies instantly. You have half the round left.

normal.text: Foe's leg catches your failing strike at the right moment. The leg is bruised badly.

magic.text: Blow to thigh leaves a bad bruise. Foe almost falls over on you. You leap clear.

mithril.text: Strike to foe's thigh. Despite his size, it sends him back. Your Mithril bites deep and leaves a painful wound.

holy.text: Foe loses his footing with your solid strike. He takes time to gain his balance. You are in good position.

slaying.text: Plunge weapon into foe's heart. Your weapon seems to know the way. The wound is instantly mortal. He dies.

normal.text: Arm strike gives foe a bruise.

magic.text: Minor forearm wound. The beast's guard is down for an instant. Press your attack.

mithril.text: Tear him up! Your strike lands along foe's arm. The wound is bleeding everywhere. It's all over you, as well.

holy.text: Tear open foe's leg with a brutal side swing. Foe is unbalanced and bleeding. His guard goes down.

slaying.text: Strike comes up under foe's arm. Blow breaks bones in upper arm. Arm is useless. Foe stumbles back.

normal.text: Strong blast to foe's stomach staggers foe. His guard drops for a moment. You have a chance.

magic.text: Hard blow to foe's back. If foe has wings they are damaged. If not, foe has broken ribs.

mithril.text: Reverse your strike to catch foe in his lower leg. He stumbles back out of reach.

holy.text: With a mighty cross swing you strike foe's head. If he has a helm (or hard head) you knock him out. If he has no helm, you behead him and he dies.

slaying.text: You see the opportunity you have needed. A legendary strike to foe's chest destroys heart and other vital organs. He drops and dies instantly.

normal.text: Strong blow to foe's leg yields a gaping wound. If foe has blood, you see a lot of it.

magic.text: You strike at foe's face. It hits and causes him some difficulty.

mithril.text: Weapon impacts upon foe's head with unmatched force. Foe comes over and is knocked out.

holy.text: Your victory strike. Your weapon crashes into foe's chest and downs him for 2 rounds. He dies in 6 rounds.

slaying.text: Blow to foe's leg slashes an artery open. Foe falls gripping his leg. He is inactive for 12 sad rounds and then dies.

normal.text: Plunge your weapon into foe's heart. Foe dies instantly, and falls on you. You are pinned for 6 rounds and +20H!

magic.text: Your weapon plunges into foe's chest. He drops and dies in 3 rounds. Your weapon is stuck in him for 12 rounds.

mithril.text: Strike foe in his head and destroy his brain. If that's not power, what is? You have half the round left to act.

holy.text: Strike foe in his ear. He dies next round. You are very confident in your combat skills.

slaying.text: True to its name, your weapon slays foe by crushing his skull. Parts of bone fly in all directions. Not a pretty sight. Foe drops instantly to the ground.

normal.text: Strike through foe's lungs. Foe falls down and dies after 6 rounds. Allies get a bonus!

magic.text: Hard but flat strike. Your weapon takes much of the impact. In addition to his wound, your weapon is broken.

mithril.text: You find a weak point and hammer foe's neck. Your weapon sticks in foe for 2 rounds, while he struggles to breathe. He dies in 6 rounds.

holy.text: Your precision surgery blinds foe. He quickly loses his direction and is in trouble.

slaying.text: Strike foe in his face. His cheek bones collapse. His neck is a bloody pulp. He dies a round later. Your weapon is lodged in foe.

normal.text: Awesome strike to shoulder sends foe stumbling. He has trouble getting his balance back.

magic.text: Strike foe in the side of his head. Foe stumbles back a few feet before he falls to the ground. He is out for 3 hours.

mithril.text: Catch foe in chin with all your weight behind the weapon. Head snaps back and chin shatters. Foe is knocked out for 30 days.

holy.text: You miss foe's weapon arm, but the strike lands on foe's knee. The results are acceptable.

slaying.text: Sever a vein in foe's forelimb. He falls to his knees. Blood is everywhere. He dies in 6 rounds.

normal.text: Strike drives bone into kidneys and liver. Foe drops and dies in 6 rounds. What a pity.

magic.text: Strike shatters foe's jaw and sends it up into his brain. Foe is dead before he hits the ground. Half round left to act.

mithril.text: Strike foe in the abdomen. The wound is mortal. A variety of important organs are destroyed on impact. Foe drops and dies after 6 rounds.

holy.text: Smooth strike to foe's cheek. Just as he was about to deal you a deadly blow, you crush the side of his head. He dies. You have half the round left.

slaying.text: You almost sever foe's head, with a mighty blow to his neck. Foe is inactive and dies in 5 rounds.

normal.text: Strike to bowels destroys foe's abdominal areas. Foe's blood is all over you. Foe dies in 12 rounds.

magic.text: Shot alongside foe's head penetrates his ear and he dies in 3 rounds. You are mighty in battle.

mithril.text: Death comes swiftly! Your strike severs an artery in foe's leg. Foe fights for 2 rounds, then drops and dies in 6 rounds.

holy.text: Strike penetrates to foe's spine. Spine is broken and foe is paralyzed from the waist down. You will not have trouble killing him.

slaying.text: Strike to abdomen damages a variety of organs. Internal bleeding will kill foe in 4 rounds. You have half the round to act.

normal.text: Blow to foe's forearm severs a vein. Foe dies in 7 rounds from shock and blood loss. He is still standing.

magic.text: Strike to foe's back. Hit severs spine. Foe is paralyzed from the neck down. Sadly, your weapon is broken.

mithril.text: Heart strike. Your foe dies in true epic form. He tumbles backwards and lands with a thunderous sound. Your strike knocks you to your knees. Foe is dead.

holy.text: Your weapon swings out and hammers foe's evil heart. He expires and your sword sings a joyful note. All who see your mighty deed are inspired by it.

slaying.text: Snap foe's head and break his neck. Foe drops and dies. You may direct another attack at anything you can reach.

normal.text: You grapple your foe and deal him a mighty blow. You are knocked out. Foe is also impaired.

magic.text: Strike through foe's eye proves fatal. He dies immediately. You avoid his fall.

mithril.text: You blind foe with a vicious crossing strike to the eyes. He grips his face and falls to his knees.

holy.text: Strike to foe's ribs punctures a lung. Foe is knocked out. Your weapon is stuck in foe for 6 rounds. Good luck.

slaying.text: Drive foe's eyes back into his skull, with a cross strike. Foe is blind and prone. Foe is in pain. He does not even try to get up.
